events.body:
## Context

No test imports `core.fuzzy`, `core.dedup` or `storage.d1_utils`. `core/fuzzy.py` is pure stdlib (Levenshtein plus trigram Jaccard) and its docstring wrongly calls trigram matching "token-set".

## What to do

1. Add `backend/tests/unit/test_fuzzy.py`: empty, identical, single edit, case, strings under 3 chars.
2. Add tests for dedup and the d1_utils conversions.
3. Fix the docstring.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] At least 10 new tests pass
- [ ] No new dependencies

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-hackerhouse
```

---
